summary: TR-808 kit for trap: short punchy kick, snappy snare and hand clap, crisp closed hat, open hat, rim
body: The Roland TR-808's own samples (tidal-drum-machines). In trap the kick is short and the long boom is the 808 bass on its own track (sound/808-bass): keep the kick under it, on the bass's first notes.
Clap and snare stacked on 3 (half-time); hats bright and busy with rolls (pattern/trap-2bar).

Apply makes a new drum track (it never replaces the old one): park the old drums (mute) at the bar the new kit starts. Pads are named by role, so drum patterns and evolve_notes find them; samples (the tool) finds other sounds to swap in with make_kit.

pattern.about: a knowledge drum pattern for it to play from the start ("pattern/trap-2bar"); leave out for an empty kit

from_bar.about: the timeline bar its region starts on (loop off: the next bar line after it lands)

bars.about: how many bars it runs (loop off: to the song's end)
